finding: Compared to scalpels, diathermy use for skin incisions in caesarean sections resulted in reduced incision time, blood loss, operative time, and postoperative pain, with no significant difference in wound healing or complications.
mod_finding: The study specifically compares modes of skin incision during caesarean section, finding that diathermy is associated with reduced incision time, blood loss, operative time, and postoperative pain compared to scalpels.
